v01.summary: Merged systematic improvements for item modification limits, completion of database actions before transfer, and strict tool usage for product details.

v02.summary: Deleted the restrictive modification rule, added requirements to load all relevant skills for multi-part requests, and ensured all changes are listed in confirmations.

v03.summary: Improved order identification scope, ensured partial fulfillment of confirmed actions, and corrected skill routing for pending order exchanges.

v04.summary: Added rules to handle price comparisons, ensure correct modification order, and confirm all items for order modifications.

v05.summary: Added rules to ensure all order statuses are verified, mandatory tool calls are executed before confirmation, and modification flow is not blocked by inaccessible information.

v06.summary: Added rules to enforce different product options for exchanges, correctly identify orders by content, and verify payment balances before proposing modifications.

v07.summary: Added procedural rules for exchange and return to ensure correct tool call timing, status management, and turn-based execution.

v08.summary: Added rules to improve order grouping, skill loading for pending exchanges, and consistency between confirmed modification summaries and tool calls.

v09.summary: Added rules to ensure policy compliance for user address modifications and exchanges, and to improve order identification accuracy.

v10.summary: Updated rules to ensure confirmed changes are completed before transfer, honor explicit escalation requests, and prevent being swayed by users on exchange options.

v11.summary: Improved calculation accuracy for cheapest items, corrected payment detail retrieval logic, and ensured progress on confirmed database changes.
